decision: p = 1 / (1 + exp(-(intercept + sum(coef[i] * x[i])))); uncached_tokens if p > threshold else cost_model_mean
encoding: cls=<c> is 1 if the observable class equals <c>, else 0 (an unseen class has all zeros); calls_done = calls (model plus tool) completed in attempt 1, unscaled

methods.cost_model_mean: posterior mean, inputs class, point, calls done, context tokens 0
methods.uncached_tokens: fewest uncached tokens to finish, tok_a + tok_b * calls done

label: 1 if the token method had lower energy per achieved goal than the cost model in the block
